t: A free retro game engine for Python with built-in art and music editors.
steps: Find Pyxel on its GitHub project page and read the README.
Ask IT to approve a Python install on managed computers.
Install Python on a test computer.
Install the pyxel package with pip.
Run a showcase example to check that it works.
Open the image and tilemap editor and draw a small sprite.
Try the web build to see whether students can play in a browser.
